{
  "problem_statement": "Within the simulation, one exhibition curator recorded counts of four and six mislabeled display pieces (C1). This suggests a possible recurring labeling problem, but absent dates, denominators and attribution prevent establishing distinct episodes, frequency or error rate (C2). The monthly summary repeats the same records rather than independently corroborating them. The observed need is exploratory; recurrence, seriousness and causes remain unresolved (C2, C3). These synthetic observations do not establish real-world need, customer validation or intervention benefit.",
  "affected_users": "The single simulated exhibition curator who recorded mislabeled pieces (C1); effects on visitors or other staff are not established.",
  "observable_problem": "Two logged counts of mislabeled display pieces, four and six, copied into a monthly summary (C1). Whether they represent separate incidents or overlapping pieces is unknown (C2).",
  "urgency": {
    "frequency": "Unknown: two counts are reported without dates or denominators; a monthly summary does not establish monthly incidence (C1, C2). Recency was not assessed (C3).",
    "severity": "unknown",
    "claim_refs": ["C1", "C2", "C3"]
  },
  "workarounds": [
    {
      "description": "Curator logging and a monthly summary document the counts; neither is shown to correct or prevent mislabeling (C1).",
      "claim_refs": ["C1"]
    }
  ],
  "alternatives": [],
  "software_hypothesis": null,
  "cross_field": null,
  "cross_field_absent_reason": "No supplied claim supports a transferable mechanism between evidence assessment and community operations. C2 identifies documentation limitations, but C3 leaves causal mechanisms unassessed; naming a transfer would exceed the evidence.",
  "evidence_strength": "exploratory",
  "gaps": [
    "C1 supplies one curator's observations, not independent corroboration. The copied monthly summary adds no independent origin (C2).",
    "Dates, denominators and attribution are absent (C2); distinct episodes, overlap, recurrence and error rates cannot be determined.",
    "Although packet passages are tagged current, recency is explicitly unassessed (C3); compliance with the stated age limit cannot be verified.",
    "Severity, consequences and causal mechanism were not assessed (C3); no urgency or intervention benefit can be inferred from counts alone.",
    "Existing alternatives were not assessed (C3), and the catalog is empty. No external search is available within scope; lack of entries does not establish a tool gap.",
    "Accessible data are only the supplied synthetic statements (C1–C3). They establish neither external validity nor real-world need, customer validation or benefit.",
    "Defer software selection. A human documentation review could first establish dated, uniquely identified incidents and total pieces inspected; this is a proposed investigation, not a tested remedy.",
    "A future outcome could be verified mislabeled pieces per inspected pieces over a defined period. No denominator, comparable baseline or measured improvement is available (C2, C3)."
  ]
}

    "frequency": "Unknown: no cancellation logs or observed cancellations establish recurrence. Absence of observations does not establish zero cancellations (C1, C2).",

  },
  "workarounds": [],
  "alternatives": [

    }
  ],
  "software_hypothesis": null,
  "cross_field": null,
  "cross_field_absent_reason": "No supplied claim supports a transferable mechanism between evidence assessment and community operations. Naming those fields alone would not justify a transfer (C1, C2).",

    "C1 is speculation, not a current observation of cancellation; recurrence, seriousness and noise attribution remain unestablished.",
    "C2 supplies no cancellation logs or affected-member observations. Accessible evidence is limited to the supplied synthetic statements.",
    "No independent corroboration is established. The author-created simulation establishes neither real-world need nor customer validation or benefit.",
    "Current workarounds, existing tools and tool deficiencies are undocumented; the catalog is empty. Alternatives cannot be meaningfully compared from this packet.",
    "No supported mechanism or software benefit is established. Human evidence gathering may suffice before any intervention is considered.",

    "severity": "unknown",
    "claim_refs": ["C1", "C2"]
  },
  "workarounds": [],

  ],
  "software_hypothesis": null,

{
  "problem_statement": "Within the author-created simulation, a ceramics studio has observations of mixed clay bins (C1). This supports investigating bin organization as a possible preparation problem, but does not establish recurrence, the cause of mixing, whether mixing is unintended, or operational harm. Color-coded item locations in a separate library procedure suggest a non-software response worth investigating, not a demonstrated solution (C2).",
  "affected_users": "Simulated ceramics studio participants handling clay bins; specific roles and number affected are not supplied (C1).",
  "observable_problem": "Mixed clay bins are reported by one author; no count, observation period, clay categories or consequences are recorded (C1).",
  "urgency": {
    "frequency": "Unknown: C1 reports observations but gives no event count, time window or rate of recurrence.",
    "severity": "unknown",
    "claim_refs": [
      "C1"
    ]
  },
  "workarounds": [],
  "alternatives": [
    {
      "description": "Investigate physical color-coded bin locations before considering software, adapting the library procedure. This is a proposed alternative, not an observed studio workaround or evaluated intervention.",
      "claim_refs": [
        "C1",
        "C2"
      ]
    }
  ],
  "software_hypothesis": null,
  "cross_field": {
    "from_field": "library organization",
    "to_field": "ceramics preparation",
    "transferred_mechanism": "Adapt color-coded item locations into designated, visibly coded locations for clay bins, so placement and retrieval can be checked against an intended location. This is a proposed physical organization mechanism, not an evaluated transfer.",
    "why_it_transfers": "Both settings involve locating physical items. Location cues could help if mixed bins result from placement or retrieval confusion; C1 does not establish that cause, and C2 explicitly states that transfer to clay handling has not been evaluated.",
    "claim_refs": [
      "C1",
      "C2"
    ]
  },
  "cross_field_absent_reason": null,
  "evidence_strength": "exploratory",
  "gaps": [
    "All evidence is synthetic and establishes neither real-world need nor customer validation or benefit.",
    "C1 is single-author evidence without independent corroboration. C2 concerns a separate procedure and does not independently corroborate the studio need.",
    "Frequency, affected participant count, severity and whether mixing is unintended are unknown; recurrence cannot be asserted.",
    "The cause of mixing is unresolved. Location coding would be less relevant if mixing arises during material handling rather than bin placement.",
    "No studio workaround, existing tool assessment or tool gap is documented; alternatives could only be considered from the supplied statements, not externally searched.",
    "Only supplied statements are accessible. No bin inventory or event-level data supports a baseline; a future measure could count unintended mixed-bin events per preparation session.",
    "C2 supplies a candidate mechanism but no transfer evaluation. Defer adoption and software recommendations pending evidence of causes, current practices and measurable harm."
  ]
}
